name: toolchain-workspace-probe
description: Deletable spec 009 POC: TS7 lint strategy (Biome + tsc) + minimal pnpm workspace. No product code, no Firebase, no root apps/packages.

scripts.check: tsc --noEmit -p packages/shared-probe/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/probe/tsconfig.json && biome lint --error-on-warnings . && biome format . && tsc -p packages/shared-probe/tsconfig.build.json && node --test apps/probe/src/main.test.ts
